achievement_get_info.notes: Obsolete platform achievement API. It can query remote user achievement information, so it remains unsafe and unsandboxed.

ads_set_reward_callback.notes: Obsolete advertising API that stores a reward callback for later platform-driven invocation.

uwp_appbar_add_element.notes: Legacy UWP shell/appbar/live-tile APIs are obsolete platform APIs. Marked unsafe and unsandboxed because they direct OS shell UI outside the exposed game surface.

uwp_device_touchscreen_available.notes: Obsolete platform query that reveals device touchscreen availability.

win8_device_touchscreen_available.notes: Obsolete platform query that reveals device touchscreen availability.

win8_license_trial_version.notes: Obsolete platform license query. Trial status reveals host entitlement information.

win8_settingscharm_get_xaml_property.notes: Obsolete Win8 host-UI query for a Settings Charm XAML property.

winphone_license_trial_version.notes: Obsolete platform license query. Trial status reveals host entitlement information.
